<!--
floatsintext: false is the APA submission convention: the figures and the
tables are collected after the body rather than set where they were written.
It did nothing at all in plain LaTeX, for two reasons at once.

apafloatstoend.lua, which does the collecting, stood down for FORMAT "latex" --
right when apa7 was the only LaTeX format apaquarto had, since apa7 collects
them itself, and wrong for a format with no apa7 behind it.

And floatlatex.lua, which chooses the placement, asked
utilsapa.stringify(m.floatsintext) ~= "false". That function opened with
`if s then`, so a yaml false -- which arrives as a lua false -- was read as an
absent field and answered the empty string, which is not "false". Every caller
asking that question was told that false meant true.

A successful run sets both floats after the body, with the placement latex
chooses rather than the H that pins a float where it stands.
-->
